tasks.prompt: Explore the synthetic example and produce something you could hand to a colleague. Explain what it does and does not establish.
Start the named fictional institution, find your questions, and record one answer with a reference and one without.
Leave and return to your saved intake. Show that your answers, role and progress are intact.
Combine the two supplied role exports, resolve the conflicting version deliberately, and export the result.
Add the candidate to the supplied disposable team repository while retaining its workflow and settings. Identify the next unfinished setup action.
Explain whether this team can start, whether institutional content is approved, and whether the platform is activated. Identify the evidence or owner still needed.
Mount the supplied fictional institutional release for the second team without re-entering its institutional answers. Explain what remains team-owned.

scope: Proposed usability targets; not institutional approval, observed results or statistical claims.
